lanes.title: without fighting, a battle changes no morale (D-085 DD1)
lanes.brief: SCOPE LIMITS: work only in prototypes/m7-sprint1 (M7Proto.slnx; M7Econ.slnx only if economy code is touched) and docs/m7-plan; no change to Sim.Core, Sim.Data, Sim.Cli, Sim.Ui or their tests, no unit data or cap change, no permanent project, no CI change (D-079 §6, Q5 open). Every design document is marked PROPOSAL; every reading is labelled READING with both alternatives; no Director decision is invented or reopened. Read docs/d085-no-fighting-no-morale-change-2026-11-11.md in full first (DD1, the readings DD1-R1 and DD1-R2, §3 narrowed and superseded, §4 delegated), then docs/d083-entering-battle-costs-morale-2026-11-10.md and docs/d082-morale-caps-ties-director-answers-2026-11-10.md, then lane MOR2's docs/m7-plan/morale-proposal.md §11 (above all §11.2, §11.3, §11.6, §11.8) and prototypes/m7-sprint1/reports/H-MOR2.md, lane AP's reports/H-AP.md (equal sides) and lane CB's reports/H-CB.md (FormationSpec.Persons, the sandbox). (1) DESIGN (update morale-proposal.md: a new section 'Without fighting, no morale change (D-085 DD1)', PROPOSAL where it is design; mark superseded statements in place, struck with a dated bold note): (a) what 'fighting' is under DD1-R2 (a) — at least one attack resolved against an enemy formation, whether or not it dealt damage — and how each resolver reports it for the whole battle (the TacticalResolver and the AutoResolver, every domain: melee, missile volleys, crew-served and domain weapons, boarding, ramming), with the reason for the source you pick (for example AttacksMade on the result's formations, or a dedicated flag); (b) the settlement under DD1-R1 (a): a battle that had fighting settles exactly as today (entry cost for every formation that entered, DR29's decrease, DA1's rise); a battle with no fighting changes no army's morale (no entry term, no decrease, no rise), recorded on the settlement row so the outcome is visible (bump the codec version if the row changes); (c) the in-battle part of the entry cost (default 0): it must never change morale in a battle that turns out to have no fighting; choose and justify one design (for example the charge falls at the battle's first fighting instant for formations already on the field and at entry for later arrivals, or the in-battle part is dropped) and implement it; (d) the War Sandbox's Quick Battle and lane S's siege battles under DD1 (implement the sandbox if it settles morale; siege as a PROPOSAL if it is not wired to the morale settlement). (2) PROTOTYPE and TESTS: implement (1). Tests: an unfought mutual rout or withdrawal changes neither army's morale, in both resolvers (lane MOR2's ProposalA_AnUnfoughtMutualRout and ProposalA_AnUnfoughtMutualWithdrawal_InTheAutoResolver cases move from +150,000 and -50,000 to 0, each change attributed to DD1); the boundary: a battle whose only attack is one that misses counts as fought (the entry cost applies) and a battle with no attack does not, turn-exact where an instant matters; a formation that entered a fought battle without striking a blow pays the entry cost (DD1-R1 (a)); a fought equal-sides win still rises (lane AP's DA1 test unchanged); the in-battle part, when switched on in a test, changes nothing before the first fighting instant; POPULATED-table round-trip tests for any changed serialized row (ExpectedLength, bit-exact round trip, hash equality); tie-dense ordering where several armies settle at one instant; every moved golden or pin with a measured attribution; bounded mutants, each killed by a semantic test. If either resolver's outputs change, measure lane P's tuning battery off and on (digests, outcome and winner changes, rule P1); lane P's acceptance stays OPEN (D-079 Q4). (3) Lane report prototypes/m7-sprint1/reports/H-MOR3.md (what exists, design, readings applied, decisions for the Director only where genuinely undecided, MEASURED vs INFERRED, tests, mutants, what ran, NOT RUN, deferred). Builds and tests: M7Proto.slnx Debug and Release, prototypes/m7-sprint1/scripts/check-proto-determinism.sh, python3 scripts/check-doc-links.py --all.
